image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Triceratops skull and frill mounted on a metal stand in an outdoor setting with green foliage in the background. The skull features two large brow horns, a smaller nasal horn, and a prominent beak. The large bony frill extends behind the head, showing surface texture resembling cracked bone or stone. The image captures the fossilized or sculpted nature of the subject rather than a living animal.
